stable.releaseNotes: Removes the local owner-editing designation requirement. A connected dashboard folder can edit when the browser has read/write access. Removes owner recovery controls and keeps existing file, update, revision, and workspace protections. No workspace migration.

beta.releaseNotes: Beta operational-control audit: adds a compact manager control pulse for overdue, due-today, missing-plan, long-vehicle, customer-update, and comeback work; puts Open RO Control ahead of Assign Next; corrects Monday Daily Walk behavior; adds direct long-vehicle/customer-update/comeback filters; protects unsaved Home and RO drafts; fixes the overview open-RO count to exclude manually closed ROs; prioritizes CSI refresh needs; improves keyboard focus/navigation semantics; and decouples software updates from the retired owner-editing policy. No Workspace migration.
